title: Confirm-pass verdicts (FR-9.5)
description: Diff-scoped confirm output: the reviewer judges, per prior finding, whether the commit-range diff addressed it. `new_findings` lets the confirm pass surface a regression it noticed in the diff without re-reviewing the whole phase, AND carry the concrete unresolved remainder of a `partially_resolved` accepted finding (pipeline-effectiveness FR-6.1, P9). Compat note (PRD §6, same rule as findings.json's engine annotations): this file is the PERSISTED confirm-record validation schema, and the P9 schema change is ADDITIVE — a `new_findings` item requires only the true pre-migration trio (`severity`, `claim`, `location`); `id`, `category`, `evidence`, `suggested_fix`, and `carried_from` are OPTIONAL on the persisted record (PR #59 review F-3: requiring them failed every genuinely pre-migration non-empty `new_findings`). So a pre-migration confirm output validates unchanged whether `new_findings` is EMPTY or carries true legacy entries (the engine's read path treats a pre-`carried_from` entry as `carried_from: null`). Strict-mode note (review F-007): native `--output-schema` requires EVERY property in `required`, so the confirmer's strict output schema — which promotes every declared item property into `required` (nullable-where-nullable, like `suggested_fix`) — is DERIVED from this persisted schema in code (see `cycle._confirmer_output_schema`); it is never emitted by hand and never governs a persisted artifact.

new_findings.description: Defects visible in the round's diff itself (scope: the diff, nothing else), AND carried remainders (FR-6.1): each entry is a COMPLETE findings-schema object plus `carried_from`. For an ordinary diff regression, `carried_from` is null. For the concrete unresolved remainder of a `partially_resolved` accepted finding, `carried_from` names that finding's id; the engine then assigns the entry a deterministic reserved-namespace id and merges it into the next round as a pre-accepted fix obligation (no re-triage).

id.description: The confirmer's id for this entry. For a carried remainder the engine OVERWRITES it with the reserved-namespace id `<carried_from>-r<round>-c<N>`; supply any placeholder.

location.description: File and line/section reference — the SPECIFIC remainder for a carried entry, not the whole parent.

claim.description: What is wrong — the specific unresolved remainder for a carried entry.

suggested_fix.description: Optional per §7 — null when the confirmer offers none.

carried_from.description: FR-6.1: the `partially_resolved` accepted finding id this entry is the remainder of, or null for an ordinary diff regression. OPTIONAL/additive on this persisted schema (PRD §6): absent or null on a pre-migration/ordinary entry, which validates unchanged. The confirmer's DERIVED strict-output schema (cycle._confirmer_output_schema) promotes it into `required` as required-but-nullable — the same convention `suggested_fix` uses — for the native `--output-schema` path.
